property_summary: For any actor and any amount, a successful ETH deposit to c must never decrease the public depositsCount() (it is non-decreasing across accepted deposits); the mutant decrements it, so after any deposit depositsCount() is strictly smaller, which the fuzzer's random amount/actor will expose.
change_summary: Replace 'depositsCount++;' with 'depositsCount--;' so a deposit decrements the counter instead of incrementing it.
